notes.title: Challenge Update is now live!
notes.content:
[img]http://goo.gl/sAsTER[/img]

The Challenge Update is now live! Compete for a highscore in the Daily Challenge, or if you're feeling more creative, design, build & share your own rooms & arenas.

This is a free update for all Time Rifters owners. 

[url=http://youtu.be/GoVgW2DPbGQ]Check out our new Time Rifters: Challenge Update trailer[/url] for a preview of the new features, or just exit & restart Steam to check them out yourself.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/270010/discussions/0/624075566838236940/]Join us on our Steam forums and let us know what you think[/url].

[img]http://goo.gl/HBxL3C[/img]

[b]Release Notes:[/b]

Gameplay Changes:
[list]
    [*]New 'Daily Challenge'. Team up with yourself in randomly created arenas of user created rooms.
    [*]New 'Custom Arenas'. Play arenas created by other players via Steam Workshop.
    [*]New 'Room Editor'. Create enemy configurations, platforms, buildings, forcefields, jump pads, triggers & wires. Your room may appear in a Daily Challenge.
    [*]New 'Arena Editor'. Point and click to create a configuration of rooms, then share that arena on the Steam Workshop.
    [*]Added 6 new Steam Achievements (Room Creator, Arena Creator, Arena Player, Daily Challenge x3)
    [*]Added 'Show/Hide Body' toggle.
[/list] 

Virtual Reality Changes:
 [list]
    [*]Updated Oculus SDK to 0.4.3.1 Beta
    [*]Added ability to toggle Vignette
[/list] 

Performance Changes:
 [list]
    [*]Reduced overdraw on explosions
    [*]Gold now uses simpler physics
    [*]Each enemy is 1 draw call instead of 2
    [*]All red/white/yellow blocks draw call batch together now
    [*]Better batching of bullet holes and weapon effects
    [*]Occlusion culling for Daily Challenge
    [*]Optimized performance of blocks on acid
[/list]

notes.title: Daily Challenge Concept
notes.content:
[img]http://goo.gl/D1u0hw[/img]

Feedback and reviews have been great! The top 2 requests are for more arenas and a level editor. After a lot of brainstorming, we've created a concept that combines those 2 requests into a Daily Challenge.

Each day a new randomly generated maze of user created rooms will be available. Once again you'll team-up with yourself to get a highscore, but this time that's done by collecting the most gold. 

If there's enough support for this game mode, we'll continue development, and it'll be released as a free Time Rifters update.

We made a short video to give you more details and a closer look at our prototype arena:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V5HLHH_gfds

We want to know what you think of the new concept. Please leave your comments/feedback here or in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/270010/discussions/0/620695877157429307/ ] Daily Challenge Steam Discussion thread [/url].

~ Jackie

notes.title: Oculus SDK 0.4.3 Beta Update
notes.content:
We've integrated the latest Oculus SDK 0.4.3 Beta that was released last Friday, but we can't release it as the default build due to performance problems vs. the 0.4.2 SDK.

We only recommend using the beta branch if you updated your Oculus Runtime to 0.4.3 and are now having trouble running Time Rifters.

If you want to try out the latest Time Rifters build that uses the 0.4.3 SDK:
[list]
[*]Restart Steam to ensure your client is up-to-date
[*]Right click on 'Time Rifters' in your Steam games list
[*]Choose the 'Betas' tab
[*]Select 'dk2 - Oculus 0.4.3 SDK'
[*]Steam will immediately do an update and switch you over
[/list]

[b]Windows[/b]
[list]
[*]If you installed the Oculus 0.4.3 Runtime, the default steam build will have a good framerate and lower latency, but the entire scene will be darker.
[*]If you installed the Oculus 0.4.3 Runtime & opt into the Time Rifters 0.4.3 SDK beta, you will likely have framerate problems.
[/list]

[b]Mac[/b]
[list]
[*]If you installed the Oculus 0.4.3 Runtime, the default steam build will have broken head tracking causing an uncomfortable experience.
[*]If you installed the Oculus 0.4.3 Runtime & opt into the Time Rifters 0.4.3 SDK beta, you will likely have framerate problems but the head tracking will be correct.
[/list]

Let us know if you run into any problems.

We'll keep you updated. If you are interested there is a discussion regarding the performance issues on the [url=https://developer.oculusvr.com/forums/viewtopic.php?f=37&t=16287]Oculus Developer Forums[/url].

notes.title: Faking Eye Tracking
notes.content:
- Added 'Vertical Offset' to Oculus headlook mode
- Added 'Vertical Scale' & 'Horizontal Scale' to Oculus headlook mode
- Both options are configurable via the controls panels

For reference: Vertical Offset adjusts the pitch of the crosshair up/down by the specified number of degrees (moving it higher or lower on the screen). It only affects headlook mode. There can be separate Vertical Offset values for gamepad vs. mouse & keyboard. Default is zero. This feature was suggested by RiftyTheRifter.

For reference: Vertical & Horizontal Scale adjusts how much the crosshair moves away from center as you turn your head. As you turn your head, you often move your eyes too, so the crosshair now moves a bit further in the direction you are looking (default is 150%). This feature was suggested by BOLL.

To make sure the game updates, restart Steam.
